meta.title: ANIC Workflow
meta.description: AI-native iteration cycle workflow graph rendered from real .cycles/ artifacts.

panel.selfInitTitle: Run skill init-workflow on the current workspace (idempotent)
panel.selfInitAlready: Workspace already initialized (.cycles/config.yml exists, rerun refused)
panel.selfInitOff: Bootstrap is disabled by switch (flow.selfInit is workspace/deployment layer only)
panel.selfInitOffTitle: This switch only supports workspace/deployment layers; the user layer cannot write it
panel.sourceMalformed: live response malformed — kept previous data
panel.traceUnavailable: Step trace projection unavailable (see data line above — no fabricated empty data)
panel.traceDisabled: Step trace section disabled by switch (degradation contract in ⚙ drawer)
panel.graphDesc: Workflow nodes and dependency edges. Keyboard: Tab into the graph, arrow keys move between nodes, Home/End jump to first/last, Enter or Space opens node detail. The data table below is the equivalent text alternative.
panel.graphTableCaption: Workflow graph equivalent data table (screen-reader text alternative)
panel.foldMemoryHint: Collapsed state is remembered per section (stored in local preferences, kept across sessions)

state.sectionFailedStale: Last fetch failed: {error} (showing last successful data)

live.title: Live invocations (dynamic white-box):
live.pollFailed: · poll failed ({error}) — showing last known data
live.pending: Waiting for first poll (this line stays while the route is unavailable or fetch is not ready — no fabricated empty state).
live.empty: No plugin invocations yet. Ask the model to call an anic_* tool or skill(ai-native-iteration-cycle) in the conversation and the calls will appear here live.
live.pollOff: Auto refresh is off (flow.autoRefresh) — use Refresh to fetch manually
live.diagnostics: channel counts: events {events} · tool calls {calls} · results {results} · anic calls {anicCalls} · anic results {anicResults}

trace.title: Step Trace (white-box projection)
trace.sources: four sources: graph={graph} nodeState={nodeState} ledger={ledger} artifacts={artifacts}
trace.heuristicTitle: Heuristic (INV-27): structured state missing, inferred from ledger verdicts
trace.producedByTitle: Producer annotation (G-T5 structured map): which script/flow produced this step's artifacts; omitted when not structurally determinable (never guessed)

org.reloadAria: Build freshness and last reload (read-only snapshot · {count} records)
org.reloadStale: dist is older than source (rebuild needed)
org.reloadNone: No reload history (cold start or never triggered)

prefs.title: Feature switches (three layers: user > workspace > deployment)
prefs.warnings: {count} switch warnings (unknown keys / invalid values ignored, see telemetry)
prefs.hint: M1: only the user layer is writable here; edit the anic section of .cycles/config.yml for the workspace layer (the single canonical entry).

cycles.title: Cycle timeline ({total} cycles)
cycles.summary: latest cycle-{latest} · next cycle-{next} · {advanced} nodes advanced in current

flows.disabled: Flow-machines panel is off (data routes and flows themselves are unaffected)

hitl.title: HITL Audit Queue
hitl.summaryCircuit: circuit broken — awaiting human (three-phase repair: audit → auto-fix → re-audit)
hitl.cliHint: Read-only queue: H4 ledger conflicts are human-only verdicts (append-only ledger, no one-click rewrite from the panel); repair goes through the skill CLI hitl-audit three-phase flow
hitl.disabled: HITL approval queue is off via switch (flow.approvals) — queue degrades to read-only display; use the skill CLI for repair actions

review.badJson: Request body is not valid JSON

gauge.ariaLabel: Autonomy level: current {current}, configured {configured}, {breakers} breaker(s); performance band {band} ({trend})
gauge.sparkline: Trend line of the last 12 scores

health.title: Skill health:
health.empty: No invocation history yet (FlowTracker empty) — health analysis appears after skill scripts are invoked.
health.noRecentData: No gateway calls in the last 7 days; current state undetermined (showing all-time value)

techdebt.empty: Zero debt — no unconsumed proposals (only failed eval dimensions produce them).

closure.title: Closure audit (register ↔ produce ↔ consume)
closure.tableUnconsumed: Unconsumed ({n}): registered but nobody reads it in this repo
closure.noneUnconsumed: No unconsumed — every registered asset has a reader.
closure.tableGhost: Ghost consumers ({n}): referenced but not registered
closure.noneGhost: No ghost consumption — every reference resolves to a registry entry.
closure.ghostHint: referenced but unregistered (consumer outlived the registry entry)
closure.bucketsTitle: Full counts (these numbers are never truncated):
closure.weakTitle: Weak evidence (counted as consumed, but not production-code consumption):
closure.weakDynamic: dynamic-key claims {n} (prefix evidence, no literal consumer)
closure.weakChannel: channel-only {n} (read only by tests / agent cards)
closure.truncated: Detail shows {shown} of {total} (the other {rest} count only in the full totals above).
closure.declaredOnly: Production anchors: no write point {nw} (locale keys are pure t() lookups), declared-but-unwired {do} — the two need different fixes.
closure.channelDeclared: channel declarations {n} (endpoints unconsumed but declared: external curl / ops / MCP clients; declaring is not an exemption)
closure.channelUndeclared: undeclared {n} (endpoints unconsumed with no declaration — ratchet red: add owner+docRef+reason or a real consumer)

group.consumedGap: Real gaps {n}: registered/produced, but nobody reads it in this repo (external consumer may be a host agent, invisible here)
group.producedGap: Never read {n}: no write point or no wiring — wire it, or delete it
group.dynamicClaimed: Dynamic-key claims {n}: prefix evidence, no literal consumer
group.channelOnly: Channel-only {n}: read only by tests / agent cards
group.declaredChannel: Declared channels {n}: called by external curl / ops / MCP clients, no production-code consumer here (declaring is not an exemption — keep the doc true)

flow.title: Flow (registered → produced → consumed)
flow.empty: No family to flow (empty projection) — explicit empty state, not a blank.

conn.broken: broken chain: {broken} hop(s) unreachable (registered but never runs)
